```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ================================================================
## SCAMP ROI-like spatial analysis: threshold sensitivity
## ---------------------------------------------------------------
## Input expected in the working directory:
##   MB_PPi_data_combined.csv
##
## Reference analysis:
##   treatment-specific thresholds, 60% lower tail + 3 scaled MAD
##
## Sensitivity grid:
##   threshold grouping: experiment-wide / treatment-specific
##   lower-tail quantile: 50% / 60% / 70%
##   MAD multiplier: 2 / 3 / 4
##
## This notebook evaluates relative spatial-pattern conclusions only.
## It must not be used for absolute fluorescence or positive-area inference.
## ================================================================

required_packages <- c(
  "tidyverse",
  "patchwork",
  "knitr",
  "lmerTest",
  "emmeans"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required package(s): ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
    ". Install them before running this notebook."
  )
}

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(knitr)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)

options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))

## -----------------------------
## Paths and output directories
## -----------------------------

analysis_root <- normalizePath(
  getwd(),
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)

scamp_data_path <- file.path(analysis_root, "MB_PPi_data_combined.csv")

output_dir <- file.path(
  analysis_root,
  "Results",
  "ROI_like_sensitivity_analysis_S5_only"
)
figure_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "Figures")
statistics_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "Statistics")
qc_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "QC")

ensure_output_dirs <- function() {
  output_directories <- c(
    output_dir,
    figure_dir,
    statistics_dir,
    qc_dir
  )

  for (current_directory in output_directories) {
    if (!dir.exists(current_directory)) {
      dir.create(
        current_directory,
        recursive = TRUE,
        showWarnings = FALSE
      )
    }
  }

  missing_directories <- output_directories[
    !vapply(output_directories, dir.exists, logical(1))
  ]

  if (length(missing_directories) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Could not create output directorie(s): ",
      paste(missing_directories, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  invisible(output_directories)
}

ensure_output_dirs()

## -----------------------------
## Analysis settings
## -----------------------------

target_length <- 1000L
fixed_columns <- 4L
reference_scenario <- "treatment__Q60_MAD3"

genotype_labels <- c(
  "2_het" = "abcc6a+/-",
  "3_mut" = "abcc6a-/-"
)

treatment_labels <- c(
  "_-PPi_-MB" = "-MB\n-PPi",
  "_-PPi_+MB" = "+MB\n-PPi",
  "_+PPi_-MB" = "-MB\n+PPi",
  "_+PPi_+MB" = "+MB\n+PPi"
)

mb_map <- c(
  "_-PPi_-MB" = "-MB",
  "_-PPi_+MB" = "+MB",
  "_+PPi_-MB" = "-MB",
  "_+PPi_+MB" = "+MB"
)

ppi_map <- c(
  "_-PPi_-MB" = "-PPi",
  "_-PPi_+MB" = "-PPi",
  "_+PPi_-MB" = "+PPi",
  "_+PPi_+MB" = "+PPi"
)

scheme_labels <- c(
  "experiment" = "Experiment-wide",
  "treatment" = "Treatment-specific"
)

scamp_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )
```

# 1. Helper functions

```{r helper-functions}
normalize_row <- function(row, target_length = 1000L) {
  row <- as.numeric(row)
  valid <- which(is.finite(row))

  if (length(valid) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, target_length))

  row <- row[min(valid):max(valid)]

  if (length(row) == 1) return(rep(row, target_length))

  approx(
    x = seq(0, 1, length.out = length(row)),
    y = row,
    xout = seq(0, 1, length.out = target_length),
    rule = 2
  )$y
}

estimate_positive_threshold <- function(pixel_matrix,
                                        background_quantile,
                                        multiplier) {
  values <- as.numeric(pixel_matrix)
  values <- values[is.finite(values) & values >= 0]

  cutoff <- unname(quantile(
    values,
    probs = background_quantile,
    names = FALSE,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    type = 7
  ))

  background_values <- values[values <= cutoff]
  baseline <- median(background_values, na.rm = TRUE)
  noise_mad <- mad(
    background_values,
    center = baseline,
    constant = 1.4826,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  tibble(
    threshold = baseline + multiplier * noise_mad,
    baseline = baseline,
    noise_mad = noise_mad,
    lower_tail_cutoff = cutoff
  )
}

extract_positive_regions <- function(binary_profile) {
  binary_profile[is.na(binary_profile)] <- FALSE
  runs <- rle(binary_profile)
  run_ends <- cumsum(runs$lengths)
  run_starts <- run_ends - runs$lengths + 1L
  positive_runs <- which(runs$values)

  if (length(positive_runs) == 0) return(tibble())

  tibble(
    region_id = seq_along(positive_runs),
    start_index = run_starts[positive_runs],
    end_index = run_ends[positive_runs],
    region_length = runs$lengths[positive_runs],
    centroid_index = (run_starts[positive_runs] + run_ends[positive_runs]) / 2,
    AP_position_percent =
      ((centroid_index - 1) / (length(binary_profile) - 1)) * 100,
    relative_region_length_percent =
      (region_length / length(binary_profile)) * 100
  )
}

format_p_value <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p), NA_character_, formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 3))
}

format_p_stars <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ "n.c.",
    p < 0.0001 ~ "****",
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p < 0.05 ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  )
}

make_threshold_groups <- function(meta, scheme) {
  switch(
    scheme,
    "experiment" = rep("all", nrow(meta)),
    "treatment" = as.character(meta$treatment),
    stop("Unknown threshold-grouping scheme: ", scheme)
  )
}
```

# 2. Load and normalize SCAMP profiles

```{r load-and-normalize-data}
if (!file.exists(scamp_data_path)) {
  stop("SCAMP input file not found: ", scamp_data_path)
}

scamp_raw <- read.csv2(
  scamp_data_path,
  header = TRUE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

if (ncol(scamp_raw) <= fixed_columns) {
  stop("No fluorescence-profile columns found after the first four metadata columns.")
}

pixel_data <- t(apply(
  scamp_raw[, (fixed_columns + 1):ncol(scamp_raw), drop = FALSE],
  1,
  normalize_row,
  target_length = target_length
))

storage.mode(pixel_data) <- "numeric"
colnames(pixel_data) <- paste0("P", seq_len(target_length))

meta <- tibble(
  fish = make.unique(as.character(scamp_raw[[1]])),
  treatment_raw = as.character(scamp_raw[[2]]),
  genotype_raw = as.character(scamp_raw[[4]])
) %>%
  mutate(
    genotype = factor(
      genotype_raw,
      levels = names(genotype_labels),
      labels = genotype_labels
    ),
    treatment = factor(
      unname(treatment_labels[treatment_raw]),
      levels = unname(treatment_labels)
    ),
    MB = factor(
      unname(mb_map[treatment_raw]),
      levels = c("-MB", "+MB")
    ),
    PPi = factor(
      unname(ppi_map[treatment_raw]),
      levels = c("-PPi", "+PPi")
    )
  )

keep <- complete.cases(meta[, c("genotype", "treatment", "MB", "PPi")])
meta <- meta[keep, ]
pixel_data <- pixel_data[keep, , drop = FALSE]

kable(
  meta %>% count(genotype, MB, PPi),
  caption = "Specimen numbers by genotype and treatment"
)
```

# 3. Define sensitivity scenarios

```{r sensitivity-scenarios}
ensure_output_dirs()

scenario_table <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  scheme = c("experiment", "treatment"),
  background_quantile = c(0.50, 0.60, 0.70),
  mad_multiplier = c(2, 3, 4)
) %>%
  mutate(
    specification = paste0(
      "Q",
      background_quantile * 100,
      "_MAD",
      mad_multiplier
    ),
    scenario_id = paste(scheme, specification, sep = "__"),
    reference = scenario_id == reference_scenario,
    scheme_label = unname(scheme_labels[scheme])
  )

if (nrow(scenario_table) != 18L ||
    !setequal(unique(scenario_table$scheme), c("experiment", "treatment"))) {
  stop("The S5 sensitivity grid must contain exactly 18 experiment/treatment scenarios.")
}

write.csv2(
  scenario_table,
  file.path(qc_dir, "ROI_like_sensitivity_scenarios.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

kable(
  scenario_table,
  caption = "Threshold sensitivity scenarios"
)
```

# 4. Scenario analysis function

```{r scenario-analysis-function}
analyse_scenario <- function(scenario_row) {
  scenario_id <- scenario_row$scenario_id[[1]]
  scheme <- scenario_row$scheme[[1]]
  background_quantile <- scenario_row$background_quantile[[1]]
  mad_multiplier <- scenario_row$mad_multiplier[[1]]

  threshold_group <- make_threshold_groups(meta, scheme)

  threshold_table <- map_dfr(unique(threshold_group), function(current_group) {
    specimen_index <- which(threshold_group == current_group)

    estimate_positive_threshold(
      pixel_data[specimen_index, , drop = FALSE],
      background_quantile = background_quantile,
      multiplier = mad_multiplier
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        scenario_id = scenario_id,
        scheme = scheme,
        background_quantile = background_quantile,
        mad_multiplier = mad_multiplier,
        threshold_group = current_group,
        n_fish = length(specimen_index),
        .before = 1
      )
  })

  specimen_threshold <- threshold_table$threshold[
    match(threshold_group, threshold_table$threshold_group)
  ]

  binary_profiles <- sweep(
    pixel_data,
    MARGIN = 1,
    STATS = specimen_threshold,
    FUN = ">"
  )
  colnames(binary_profiles) <- paste0("P", seq_len(ncol(binary_profiles)))

  regions <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(meta)), function(i) {
    extract_positive_regions(binary_profiles[i, ]) %>%
      mutate(
        scenario_id = scenario_id,
        fish = meta$fish[i],
        genotype = meta$genotype[i],
        treatment = meta$treatment[i],
        MB = meta$MB[i],
        PPi = meta$PPi[i],
        .before = 1
      )
  })

  if (nrow(regions) == 0 || sd(regions$AP_position_percent) == 0) {
    stop("No usable spatial regions in scenario ", scenario_id)
  }

  AP_mean <- mean(regions$AP_position_percent, na.rm = TRUE)
  AP_sd <- sd(regions$AP_position_percent, na.rm = TRUE)

  regions <- regions %>%
    mutate(AP_position_scaled = (AP_position_percent - AP_mean) / AP_sd)

  region_length_model <- lmerTest::lmer(
    relative_region_length_percent ~
      genotype * MB * PPi * AP_position_scaled +
      (1 | fish),
    data = regions,
    REML = FALSE
  )

  region_length_type3 <- anova(
    region_length_model,
    type = 3,
    ddf = "Satterthwaite"
  ) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    mutate(
      scenario_id = scenario_id,
      p_value = `Pr(>F)`,
      significance = format_p_stars(p_value),
      .before = 1
    )

  region_slopes <- emmeans::emtrends(
    region_length_model,
    specs = ~ genotype * MB * PPi,
    var = "AP_position_scaled"
  )

  slopes_table <- as.data.frame(
    summary(region_slopes, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))
  ) %>%
    mutate(scenario_id = scenario_id, .before = 1)

  ppi_contrasts <- contrast(
    region_slopes,
    method = "revpairwise",
    by = c("genotype", "MB"),
    adjust = "none"
  )

  ppi_contrasts_table <- as.data.frame(
    summary(ppi_contrasts, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      scenario_id = scenario_id,
      p_value_raw = p.value,
      p_value_BH = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
      significant_BH = p_value_BH < 0.05,
      direction = case_when(
        estimate > 0 ~ "positive",
        estimate < 0 ~ "negative",
        TRUE ~ "zero"
      ),
      .before = 1
    )

  list(
    thresholds = threshold_table,
    regions = regions,
    region_length_type3 = region_length_type3,
    slopes = slopes_table,
    ppi_slope_contrasts = ppi_contrasts_table
  )
}
```

# 5. Run all sensitivity scenarios

```{r run-sensitivity-scenarios}
ensure_output_dirs()

scenario_results <- vector("list", nrow(scenario_table))
scenario_errors <- vector("list", nrow(scenario_table))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(scenario_table))) {
  current_scenario <- scenario_table[i, , drop = FALSE]

  scenario_results[[i]] <- tryCatch(
    analyse_scenario(current_scenario),
    error = function(e) {
      scenario_errors[[i]] <<- tibble(
        scenario_id = current_scenario$scenario_id,
        error_message = conditionMessage(e)
      )
      NULL
    }
  )
}

successful_results <- scenario_results[!vapply(
  scenario_results,
  is.null,
  logical(1)
)]

error_table <- bind_rows(scenario_errors)

if (nrow(error_table) == 0) {
  error_table <- tibble(
    scenario_id = character(),
    error_message = character()
  )
}

if (length(successful_results) == 0) {
  stop("All sensitivity scenarios failed. See the error table.")
}

all_thresholds <- map_dfr(successful_results, "thresholds")
all_region_length_type3 <- map_dfr(successful_results, "region_length_type3")
all_slopes <- map_dfr(successful_results, "slopes")
all_ppi_slope_contrasts <- map_dfr(successful_results, "ppi_slope_contrasts")

write.csv2(
  error_table,
  file.path(qc_dir, "ROI_like_sensitivity_model_errors.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

kable(
  tibble(
    requested_scenarios = nrow(scenario_table),
    successful_scenarios = length(successful_results),
    failed_scenarios = nrow(error_table)
  ),
  caption = "Sensitivity analysis completion summary"
)
```

# 6. Stability relative to the reference analysis

```{r reference-stability}
ensure_output_dirs()

reference_region_terms <- all_region_length_type3 %>%
  filter(scenario_id == reference_scenario) %>%
  select(
    term,
    reference_p_value = p_value,
    reference_significant = significance
  )

region_term_stability <- all_region_length_type3 %>%
  left_join(reference_region_terms, by = "term") %>%
  mutate(
    significant = p_value < 0.05,
    reference_significant_logical = reference_p_value < 0.05,
    same_significance = significant == reference_significant_logical
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    scenario_table %>% select(scenario_id, scheme, specification, reference),
    by = "scenario_id"
  )

reference_ppi_contrasts <- all_ppi_slope_contrasts %>%
  filter(scenario_id == reference_scenario) %>%
  select(
    genotype,
    MB,
    reference_estimate = estimate,
    reference_p_BH = p_value_BH,
    reference_direction = direction,
    reference_significant_BH = significant_BH
  )

ppi_contrast_stability <- all_ppi_slope_contrasts %>%
  left_join(
    reference_ppi_contrasts,
    by = c("genotype", "MB")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    same_direction = direction == reference_direction,
    same_significance = significant_BH == reference_significant_BH
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    scenario_table %>% select(scenario_id, scheme, specification, reference),
    by = "scenario_id"
  )

key_region_terms <- c(
  "genotype:PPi",
  "PPi:AP_position_scaled",
  "genotype:PPi:AP_position_scaled"
)

key_region_term_summary <- region_term_stability %>%
  filter(term %in% key_region_terms) %>%
  group_by(term, scheme) %>%
  summarise(
    scenarios = n(),
    significant_scenarios = sum(significant, na.rm = TRUE),
    significance_agreement = mean(same_significance, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_p = min(p_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_p = max(p_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ppi_contrast_summary <- ppi_contrast_stability %>%
  group_by(genotype, MB, scheme) %>%
  summarise(
    scenarios = n(),
    same_direction = mean(same_direction, na.rm = TRUE),
    significance_agreement = mean(same_significance, na.rm = TRUE),
    significant_scenarios = sum(significant_BH, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_estimate = min(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_estimate = max(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv2(
  region_term_stability,
  file.path(statistics_dir, "ROI_like_region_length_term_stability.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv2(
  ppi_contrast_stability,
  file.path(statistics_dir, "ROI_like_PPi_slope_contrast_stability.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv2(
  key_region_term_summary,
  file.path(statistics_dir, "ROI_like_key_spatial_conclusion_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv2(
  ppi_contrast_summary,
  file.path(statistics_dir, "ROI_like_PPi_slope_contrast_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

kable(
  key_region_term_summary,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Stability of the key region-length interaction terms"
)

kable(
  ppi_contrast_summary,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Stability of PPi effects on AP-axis slopes"
)
```

# 8. Sensitivity visualizations

```{r sensitivity-visualizations, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
plot_region_terms <- region_term_stability %>%
  filter(term %in% key_region_terms) %>%
  mutate(
    scheme = factor(scheme, levels = names(scheme_labels), labels = scheme_labels),
    specification = factor(
      specification,
      levels = scenario_table %>%
        arrange(background_quantile, mad_multiplier) %>%
        distinct(specification) %>%
        pull(specification)
    )
  )

p_term_stability <- ggplot(
  plot_region_terms,
  aes(x = specification, y = -log10(p_value), colour = term, group = term)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = 2, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ scheme, ncol = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  scamp_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Threshold specification",
    y = expression(-log[10](p)),
    title = "Stability of key spatial interaction terms"
  )

plot_ppi_contrasts <- ppi_contrast_stability %>%
  mutate(
    scheme = factor(scheme, levels = names(scheme_labels), labels = scheme_labels),
    specification = factor(
      specification,
      levels = scenario_table %>%
        arrange(background_quantile, mad_multiplier) %>%
        distinct(specification) %>%
        pull(specification)
    )
  )

p_ppi_contrast_stability <- ggplot(
  plot_ppi_contrasts,
  aes(
    x = specification,
    y = estimate,
    colour = genotype,
    group = genotype
  )
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = significant_BH), size = 2.2) +
  facet_grid(MB ~ scheme, scales = "free_x") +
  scamp_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Threshold specification",
    y = "PPi effect on AP-axis slope (+PPi minus -PPi)",
    title = "Stability of PPi slope contrasts"
  )

p_term_stability
p_ppi_contrast_stability
```
